_meta.name: Scheduling uses 30-min default and invite-only (no redundant email)
_meta.description: When the user asks to schedule a meeting without specifying duration, the system must default to 30 minutes (not 60). When creating a calendar invite, the system must NOT also send a confirmation email — the invite IS the notification. Tests both the duration default and the invite-vs-email rule.
